summary: Independent review found no blocker or important issues. All 100 rows match the deposited samples_list.xlsx (donor, treatment, explant replicate, medium vs cartilage extract) and all 100 PRIDE RAW files; ontology terms resolve; official validator passes with warnings only. Minor findings only.

reviewer_context.context: fresh adversarial reviewer subagent without producer transcript; producer report treated as untrusted and not relied on

spec_compliance.evidence: Templates declared ms-proteomics v1.1.0 + human v1.1.0, consistent with Homo sapiens LC-MS DDA data; 30 columns on all 101 lines, no CR/trailing whitespace; 100 unique source names/assay names/data files; sdrf-tools structure OK; required human columns age/sex use allowed reserved word 'not available'.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in local cache: BTO:0000316 culture medium, UBERON:0010996 articular cartilage of joint, PATO:0000461 normal, MS:1002038 label free sample, PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition, MS:1002877 Q Exactive HF-X, MS:1001251 trypsin, UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation. sdrf-tools check --offline: 0 hallucinated, 0 label mismatch, CLEAN. Treatment values are free text (validator warnings only; column is optional).

source_evidence.evidence: samples_list.xlsx: 84 'explant media' runs (donors 1-7 x N/D/IC/ICD x 3 explants) and 16 'cartilage extract' runs (donors 4-7 x 4 conditions, 'pooled 123'); programmatic row-by-row comparison of treatment, individual, organism part, replicate and file gave 0 mismatches (incl. irregular donor4 ICD2_11/ICD3_12/ICD4_10 ordering). Paper/PRIDE Methods: Q Exactive HF-X, trypsin-based search, CAM C fixed, Ox M/P variable, MS1 10 ppm, Sequest MS2 0.02 Da; Collins grade 0-1 donors support disease=normal. Trypsin additionally stated per sample in samples_list.xlsx digestion enzyme column, so the reconcile 'cleavage_agent_unsupported' flag is a false positive.

file_mapping.evidence: files_compact.json: 100 RAW files; SDRF comment[data file] has 100 unique entries, exact set equality with PRIDE RAW list; non-raw (.msf, .xlsx) files correctly excluded; assay name == data file stem on every row.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 7 donors x 4 conditions x 3 explants = 84 media runs + 4 donors x 4 conditions pooled cartilage = 16; factor value[treatment] equals characteristics[treatment] on all rows (4 levels, balanced 25 rows each); biological replicate 1-3 per donor x condition for media, 1 for pooled cartilage with pooled sample='pooled'; technical replicate 1, fraction 1 (no fractionation described).

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than evidence: age/sex left 'not available' because the paper gives an unmapped cohort list; no invented instrument/tolerance/modification beyond Methods; cell type 'not applicable'. Omitted optional context (ankle joint origin, cytokine doses, 21-day culture, media batch) is noted as minor findings.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t human --use_ols_cache_only: exit 0, 4 warnings (free-text treatment not in ncit/efo), no errors. sdrf-tools check --offline: exit 0 CLEAN. sdrf-tools score: 97/100. sdrf-tools structure: OK. sdrf-tools reconcile: 1 flag (trypsin) adjudicated false positive against samples_list.xlsx.

findings.location: characteristics[treatment] / factor value[treatment], IC vs ICD rows
findings.message: IC value says 'single-impact mechanical injury + TNF-alpha/IL-6/sIL-6R' while ICD says 'mechanical injury + TNF-alpha/IL-6/sIL-6R + dexamethasone 100 nM'; cytokine doses (25/50/250 ng/mL) and 21-day duration are omitted, and the template suggests 'untreated' for controls rather than 'no treatment'.
findings.evidence: Paper Methods define IC as single-impact injury + 25 ng/mL TNF-a + 50 ng/mL IL-6 + 250 ng/mL sIL-6R; ICD = IC + 100 nM Dex.

findings.location: characteristics[organism part], 84 medium rows and 16 cartilage rows
findings.message: Media rows carry only 'culture medium' (BTO:0000316) and cartilage rows the generic 'articular cartilage of joint'; the ankle talocrural osteochondral explant origin (UBERON:0001488 ankle joint; bone also present) is not recorded anywhere.
findings.evidence: PRIDE organismParts lists articular cartilage, ankle joint, bone; paper: explants from ankle talocrural joints with ~4 mm bone.

findings.message: Paper lists donor demographics (62F, 66M, 66M, 44F, 23M, 39M, 70M) without an explicit donor-number mapping; 'not available' is the safe choice, but a producer could seek author confirmation of the ordinal mapping to HDP1-7.
Paper reports a media batch effect from two donor collections; no batch/collection column is annotated (acquisition dates 210909/210917/210921 in file names).
findings.evidence: Bioinformatics analyses: 'The media data had significant batch effects due to two collections of donors'.

findings.message: Manifest cites scratchpad/PXD032213/evidence/raw_header_check.json, which does not exist; instrument is nevertheless supported by PRIDE record and paper.
